sloka: बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णम् तौ वा दशरथात्मजौ ।अथवा कपिनैकेन कृतम् नः कदनम् महत् ॥६-१२-२१॥।।
transliteration: bahusattvasamākīrṇam tau vā daśarathātmajau ।athavā kapinaikena kṛtam naḥ kadanam mahat ॥6-12-21॥।।

translations.english: "Even so, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."
translations.hindi: परन्तु उपाय का अवलंबन किए बिना जो काम मनमाने उल्टे सीधे किए जाते हैं, वे सब उसो प्रकार दूषित होते हैं, जिस प्रकार अपवित्र हव्य की आहति
